reader.title: Subexponential bound in treewidth under ETH · Fixed common palette

sourceBasis.step: Give every vertex of a 3-Coloring instance the list {1, 2, 3}, a subset of the fixed palette [q]. The graph and treewidth are unchanged. A treewidth-subexponential algorithm would also be subexponential in the number of vertices, since treewidth is at most the graph order.

statement: Under ETH, no deterministic algorithm decides List Coloring within the stated running time.
